Guidance & outlook: I am pleased to report that Kross Limited has concluded its best top line in Q1 FY27 with a sale of INR185.35 crore s, registering a growth of 32% year -on-year, building on the strong momentum of Q4 FY26.

Firstly, for the quarter which has ended June 30, 2026, as far as our revenue is concerned, it's at INR184.3 crores, registering a strong 32.3% growt h compared to INR139.3 crores in quarter one of FY26.

So if we look at our DRHP, the largest five customers were around INR209 crore s in FY22, then it increased to INR409 crores in FY24, and based on our results for FY26, the largest five customers contributed to INR379 crores.
Growth & demand: EBITDA grew by 39.5% year -on-year to 225.54 million with margin expansions to 12.23%, while PAT increased 24.4% year -on-year to 133.12 million.
The extruded axle beam has started production and volumes on axles and suspensions have increased 30% year-on-year.
Regarding exports, the efforts are underway to grow share in export in line with our projections, which is supported by a 45% growth year -on-year.
Margins & costs: The margins right now are at -- for quarter one are at 12.23%, up 63 bps Y -o-Y, reflecting Kross Limited July 27, 2026 operational efficiency, a better product mix, and benefits from our backward integration.
Overall, Q1 FY27 reflects robust top line growth with margin improvement and a disciplined approach towards our costs.

Secondly is because of all the input costs increasing from the month of March right up to now in terms of LPG, other gases, tooling, and oil and lubricants, there is also a talk on the conversion price increase which is supposed to be passed on to the suppliers.
Capex & expansion: I'll brief you now on certain capacity expansions and new initiatives.
This has been achieved and the funds deployed towards capacity expansion and working capital have been as per plan.
We are confident that with the ongoing capacity expansions and also our new product launches, it will further support profitable growth in the coming quarters.
Balance sheet & cash: And secondly, in terms of seamless tube, we have already taken the necessary term loan and debt for that.
For our existing business, there is no plan on any debt in the immediate timeline.
Risks & challenges: The period of June, July are where demands are slightly subdued due to monsoon.
A high-pressure mold line for our foundry is expected to start in Q3.
We have already increased that and prices have to be in line with what competition is.
